# Security policy

Use the latest published release when available. Report a suspected vulnerability privately to **truongleanhvu20052004@gmail.com** with the subject **Drive Markdown Reader security report**.

Include the affected version or commit, browser version, impact, and a minimal reproduction using shareable data. Remove credentials and private Drive URLs. Coordinate public disclosure with the maintainer.

Use the public issue tracker for ordinary bugs. See [privacy and permissions](../docs/guides/PRIVACY.md) for the extension's data handling.
